summary: Phase 16.5 Appointments List (MedicDr-style table) regression PASS. Default view = List (localStorage cleared, appts-list-view rendered). All 9 headers render in exact order: Name | Email | Appointment | Time | Mode | Contact | Doctor | Tests | Recs. Row-testid format is `appts-list-row-<full appointment_id>`. Chip mapping verified across all 3 seeded appointments: Today ['Pure Tone Audiometry','Speech Audiometry','Impedance Audiometry'] -> PTA / SPEECH / IA; Tomorrow ['PTA','IA','Hearing Aid Trial'] -> PTA / IA / HAT; +2 days ['OAE','ABR','Tinnitus Match','VEMP'] -> OAE / ABR / TIN / VEMP. All 10 TEST_ABBR regex branches exercised at least once (PTA, SPEECH, IA, HAT, OAE, ABR, TIN, VEMP verified live; SFA / VRA covered by regex only). Cyan palette (rgb(8,145,178)=cyan-600) confirmed on Add Appointment btn, active view-toggle (Board+List), and active status chip (Scheduled). Mode pill renders 'Offline' with slate style for all 3 seeded rows (they were created without an explicit `mode` field so the modeOf() fallback correctly yields Offline). Approve icon [data-testid=appts-list-approve-<id>] navigates to /patients/<patient_id> (verified: /patients/ACS-2026-533ECA1B). Cancel icon [data-testid=appts-list-cancel-<id>] present (placeholder only). Recs text 'Follow up in 3 months' visible with title-attribute tooltip. Board toggle -> appt-card-<id> grid; List toggle returns to table. All filter chips (all/scheduled/in_queue/attending/complete/cancelled) present and filter behaves correctly. BookAppointmentModal opens on Add-Appointment click. Navigating to /patients then back to /patients/appointments preserves list view and produces no new console errors.

minor.issue: The three seeded appointments have `mode=null` in the DB (not `offline` / `online` as review-request implied). Because the frontend modeOf() falls back to 'Offline' for missing mode, the Online-pill code path is NOT exercised in preview by any seeded row. Also the actual appointment_ids in the DB are `APT-A8FF8C3E-2`, `APT-45498A41-7`, `APT-BAA5DCB1-D` (with trailing suffixes), not the shorter IDs (`APT-A8FF8C3E` etc.) stated in the review request — no functional impact since the UI keys off `appointment_id` verbatim, but the doc drift is worth noting.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update the 3 seeded appointments' `mode` field so at least one row (APT-45498A41-7 per review request) surfaces the cyan 'Online' pill in preview. Currently all three have mode=null and render as 'Offline'. Suggestion: PATCH /api/appointments/APT-45498A41-7 with body {mode: 'online'}.

OPTIONAL: Reconcile the review-request appointment IDs (APT-A8FF8C3E / APT-45498A41 / APT-BAA5DCB1) with the actual DB IDs which carry a trailing suffix (`-2`, `-7`, `-D`). Either shorten the DB ids or fix the doc.

PRE-EXISTING (not Phase 16.5): React hydration warning about <span> nested inside <option> in BookAppointmentModal (DURATIONS select). Same warning was flagged in iteration_37. Not blocking but should eventually be fixed — replace the emergent-injected wrapper with an inline text render or move the visual override to a class on the <option>.

PRE-EXISTING: 4x 'Failed to load resource: 500' console entries observed on the Appointments page load. Not blocking UI — appointments still render — but a backend endpoint used by the layout (likely /api/notifications or a snapshot endpoint) is 500-ing. Recommend adding backend log inspection for these requests to identify the failing endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: AppointmentsBoard.jsx is now 483 lines with two components (AppointmentsBoard + ListView + ApptCard + helpers) in a single file — approaching but still under the 700-line ceiling. Consider extracting ListView and ApptCard into ./components/AppointmentsListView.jsx and ./components/AppointmentsBoardView.jsx for readability, and moving TEST_ABBR into ./lib/testAbbreviations.js so other modules (patient timeline, session summary) can reuse the mapping instead of re-implementing it.

The Cancel action button (appts-list-cancel-<id>) currently has an inert onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()} — this is a UX placeholder that will confuse users who click and see nothing happen. Wire it to a confirm dialog + PATCH /api/appointments/<id> {status: 'cancelled'} + optimistic UI update.

testChip() fallback uses raw.slice(0,4).toUpperCase() — for unknown tests this can produce awkward labels like 'BONE' from 'Bone Conduction' or truncated strings. Consider a friendlier fallback (initials of each word) or an explicit '???' label so users learn to configure a mapping.

The Recs column merges recommendation/follow_up/notes/complaint into one string but shows only the first non-empty one — the UI gives no visual hint about which field the shown text came from. For clinicians, prefixing 'Rec:' vs 'Note:' would remove ambiguity.
